title: Ticket #10421 - Standard Refund Window Eligibility
content: Customer requested full refund on day 11 following initial purchase of annual license. Agent confirmed compliance with 14-day policy window and issued $1,200 refund to original payment card.
author: Support Agent Maria K.

title: Ticket #10488 - Refund Request Rejected on Day 16
content: Customer submitted refund request on day 16 post-purchase. Policy strictly limits standard refunds to 14 calendar days. Request rejected per Billing Policy v3.0 section 4; customer offered technical onboarding session instead.
author: Support Agent Sarah T.

title: Ticket #10530 - Enterprise 30-Day Evaluation Refund Exception
content: Enterprise client Apex Global requested evaluation refund on day 24. While consumer portal lists 14 days, client MSA contract includes 30-day proof-of-concept clause. Exception approved under Enterprise Policy Addendum.
author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

title: Ticket #10612 - Mid-Term Pro-Rated Subscription Refund Denied
content: Customer requested pro-rated refund 6 months into their annual subscription after moving companies. Explained that annual plans are discounted upfront and non-refundable beyond the initial 14-day window. Account set to cancel at end of term.
author: Support Agent Maria K.

title: Ticket #10675 - Subscription Cancellation Timing Clarification
content: Inquiry regarding cancellation timeline. When a user clicks 'Cancel Subscription', access remains active until the end of the current paid billing cycle. No immediate account termination occurs unless requested explicitly for security compliance.
author: Support Agent Chen W.

title: Ticket #10720 - Failed Payment Grace Period and Lockout
content: Customer credit card expired causing recurring payment failure. System initiated 72-hour grace period with automated retry at 24h, 48h, and 72h marks. Customer updated card details within 48h, preventing automated account suspension.
author: Support Agent Sarah T.

title: Ticket #10781 - Duplicate Charge Discrepancy via Stripe Webhook
content: Client reported two $450 charges on Feb 26. Investigation revealed duplicate charge event dispatched during Stripe webhook gateway migration. Second transaction was voided and refunded within 2 hours.
author: Billing Specialist Elena R.

title: Ticket #10840 - International Currency Conversion Discrepancy
content: Customer billed in GBP noticed slight variance from USD pricing table. Clarified that international billing utilizes daily spot exchange rates plus local statutory VAT (20% for UK). Tax breakdown was provided to customer.
author: Support Agent Chen W.

title: Ticket #9842 - 2024 SLA Outage Credit Claim
content: Customer submitted formal claim for 10% credit following US-East downtime in November 2024. Under 2024 SLA agreement, uptime dropped to 99.7% (below 99.9% guarantee). Manual claim verified and 10% invoice credit granted.
author: Operations Liaison Dan P.

title: Ticket #10915 - Automatic 15% Outage Credit Under 2025 SLA
content: Customer inquired why their February invoice showed an unrequested 15% discount. Confirmed that under the revised 2025 SLA policy, monthly uptime of 99.88% breached the 99.95% target, triggering an automatic 15% credit without manual filing.
author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

title: Ticket #10960 - Scheduled Maintenance Excluded from SLA Uptime
content: Client contested 45 minutes of scheduled maintenance on Sunday 02:00 UTC as an SLA breach. Pointed out Section 3.2 of Master Services Agreement: scheduled maintenance windows announced 5 business days in advance are excluded from downtime calculations.
author: Operations Liaison Dan P.

title: Ticket #11005 - Multi-Region High Availability SLA Guarantee
content: Enterprise Tier-1 contract inquiry regarding multi-region active-active deployments. Service contract specifies 99.99% uptime for multi-region configurations, backed by a 25% credit if regional failover exceeds 120 seconds.
author: Solutions Architect Vikram S.

title: Ticket #11050 - Missing CSV Export Option in Analytics UI
content: User reported that the 'Export to CSV' button vanished from the analytics dashboard after the weekend deploy. Advised user that CSV export was deprecated and permanently removed in release v2.4 due to spreadsheet macro injection vulnerabilities.
author: Support Agent Sarah T.

title: Ticket #11082 - Guidance for Alternative Data Export (JSON & Parquet)
content: Following CSV export removal, client data team asked for programmatic export guidance. Provided API documentation for /api/v2/export endpoint which streams newline-delimited JSON or Apache Parquet formats with SHA256 checksums.
author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

title: Ticket #11120 - Request for Legacy CSV Export Override Denied
content: Customer requested a temporary tenant flag to re-enable CSV export for legacy downstream ETL pipelines. Security team denied the request; corporate policy prohibits unescaped CSV serialization across all production clusters.
author: Senior Escalations Agent Mike D.

title: Ticket #11175 - Kafka Cluster High Availability Sizing Rules
content: Client configuring dedicated message broker requested cluster sizing guidelines. Confirmed architecture requirement: Kafka clusters must be provisioned with at least 3 broker nodes across distinct AZs with replication factor 3 and min.insync.replicas=2.
author: Solutions Architect Vikram S.

title: Ticket #11210 - SQLite Database Lock Contention in High-Concurrency Worker
content: Client self-hosting local worker nodes encountered 'database is locked' errors. Advised enabling WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode via PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and setting busy_timeout to 5000ms in connection pool configuration.
author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

title: Ticket #11265 - REST API Rate Limit Thresholds and Headers
content: Developer inquiry regarding 429 Too Many Requests response codes. Standard tier API rate limit is 1,000 requests per minute; Enterprise tier accommodates up to 5,000 requests per minute. Rate limit status is returned in X-RateLimit-Remaining headers.
author: Technical Support Engineer Alex B.

title: Ticket #11302 - Outbound Webhook Delivery Retry Policy
content: Customer asked about dropped webhook delivery guarantees. EvidenRoute retries failed webhook deliveries up to 5 times using exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h) over a 24-hour window before tagging endpoint as unhealthy.
author: Support Agent Chen W.

title: Ticket #11350 - Unidentified Third-Party Quantum Adapter Failure
content: Customer submitted ticket inquiring why their third-party quantum entanglement connector module failed to initialize. Agent noted that no such quantum adapter or driver exists in EvidenRoute product catalog; recommended consulting external vendor.
author: Support Agent Maria K.
